new.text: Figure 7.5: Global Supervision Status [SWS_PHM_00217] One Global Supervision Status per Global Supervision Upstream requirements: RS_PHM_00111 ⌈The Platform Health Management shall have one Global Supervision Status per GlobalSupervision configured.⌋ Each GlobalSupervision is a set of Alive Supervision , Deadline Su- pervision and/or Logical Supervision corresponding to a single Function Group. There can be one or more GlobalSupervision per Function Group . But a GlobalSupervision does not span across multiple Function Groups .
